symptoms.name: Squealing when braking
symptoms.check: Look at the pad thickness through the wheel and for a lip on the disc.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Grinding when braking
symptoms.check: Stop driving: pads may be down to the metal.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Car pulls to one side
symptoms.check: Check tyre pressures first, then whether one wheel is hot after a drive.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Knock over bumps
symptoms.check: Rock each wheel and lever each joint to find the play.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Hum that rises with speed
symptoms.check: Note whether it changes when turning left or right.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Overheating
symptoms.check: With the engine cold, check the coolant level and look for leaks.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: White smoke and coolant loss
symptoms.check: A garage block test for combustion gas in the coolant.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Blue smoke
symptoms.check: Check the oil level often and look for oil in the intake pipes.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Misfire or rough idle
symptoms.check: Read the fault codes; they usually name the cylinder.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Slow cranking or clicking on start
symptoms.check: Measure the battery: about 12.6 V at rest, 13.8–14.6 V running.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Battery light on while driving
symptoms.check: Check the belt is there and tight.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Squeal from the engine at start-up
symptoms.check: Look at the belt's ribs and spin the pulleys by hand.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Clutch slips or bites high
symptoms.check: Try pulling away in third gear gently: a healthy clutch stalls the engine.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Clicking on full lock
symptoms.check: Look for a split boot and grease on the inside of the wheel.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Rattle at idle that stops with the clutch down
symptoms.check: Common on diesels with a dual-mass flywheel.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Rattle after a cold start
symptoms.check: If it lasts more than a few seconds, have the timing checked soon.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Heater fan works only on top speed
symptoms.check: The resistor is the usual cause.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Steamy windows and damp carpets
symptoms.check: A sweet smell inside points to the heater matrix.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Hard starting on a cold diesel
symptoms.check: Test the glow plugs' resistance.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.

symptoms.name: Engine warning light
symptoms.check: Read the code before buying any part.
symptoms.source: Written for @family. from general workshop diagnosis practice; a guide to where to look, not a diagnosis.
